title: Faisal Town Phase 2 Sector T – Full-Payment Plots, Prices & Plan
description: Explore Sector T full-payment plots, listed prices, the official sector plan and current availability. Ask for today’s Sector T plot options.
intro: Explore Sector T full-payment prices from PKR 33.80 Lac for a listed 5.56 Marla plot with plot number. Check the updated schedule and ask us to confirm current plot availability.
secondaryCta: Ask for a Marked Sector T Plan
priceTableNote: Rate schedule effective 02 November 2026. The final column shows the discounted price with plot number. Confirm the exact available plot and itemized total.
body:
## Full-payment plot prices

The price schedule effective 02 November 2026 lists these sizes and discounted prices with plot number: 5.56 Marla at PKR 3,380,000, 8 Marla at PKR 4,650,000, 10.89 Marla at PKR 6,150,000, 14.22 Marla at PKR 7,690,000, 1 Kanal at PKR 10,390,000, 2 Kanal at PKR 19,990,000, 2 Kanal at PKR 21,190,000. Ask for the exact available plot number and a complete quotation before deciding.

## Sector T plan and plot location

Use the official Sector T plan to compare plot dimensions, road position and nearby open areas. Ask us to mark an available plot and share its location pin.

## Your complete quotation

The rate schedule lists PKR 20,000 registration and states that development charges are included. Ask for an itemized total for your chosen plot, including any applicable special-location charges.

## Arrange a site visit

Share your preferred size and budget. We can help you shortlist an available plot, confirm its location and arrange a site visit.

faqsText:
What are the latest listed prices in Sector T? | The schedule effective 02 November 2026 lists seven sizes from 5.56 Marla to 2 Kanal. The 5.56 Marla discounted price with plot number is PKR 3,380,000. Ask for current availability and the full quotation.
Which plot sizes are listed? | 5.56 Marla, 8 Marla, 10.89 Marla, 14.22 Marla, 1 Kanal and two 2 Kanal dimensions are listed.
How can I check current plot numbers? | Share your preferred size and budget. We can help mark available plots on the Sector T plan.
Are there installment options? | Ask separately about possible K Block options for 10 marla and above, subject to current availability and confirmation.
What charges should I include? | The schedule lists PKR 20,000 registration and includes development charges. Ask for an itemized quote with any applicable location charges.
